item.title: Version 1.23.0
item.description:
New

  • Auto-generate background colors from recording content
  • Copy exported video directly to clipboard
  • Support for landscape device frames with bezel rotation
  • Multi-display region recording

Improved

  • Configurable export frame rates (24, 30, 60 FPS)
  • Redesigned recording overlay with compact, always-visible control bar
  • Customizable zoom speeds per individual zoom
  • Hover effects on control bar buttons
  • Aspect ratio constraining during selection and resizing
  • Hide display capture option when only one monitor is present
  • Faster release builds

Fixed

  • Session persistence not retaining edits on old recordings
  • Desktop icons no longer hidden when starting window recording
  • Zoom timing now adjusts properly when extending zoom duration
